mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS system_manpower, SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_actual_attendance = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS actual_attendance, SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_inventory = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inventory_manpower, SUM(CASE WHEN a.receive_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS receive_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.support_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS support_count FROM employee e LEFT JOIN attendance_daily a ON e.id = a.employee_id AND a.date = #{date} AND a.shift = #{shift} WHERE e.dept_id = #{deptId}

SELECT e.section AS section, e.name AS name, e.employee_no AS employeeId, e.type AS type, a.meeting_roll_call AS meetingRollCall, (SELECT name FROM dept WHERE id = a.out_support_dept_id) AS outSupportSection, CASE WHEN a.receive_flag = 1 THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS isReceive, CASE WHEN a.support_flag = 1 THEN '是' ELSE '否' END AS support, e.esd_submitter AS esdSubmitter FROM employee e LEFT JOIN attendance_daily a ON e.id = a.employee_id AND a.date = #{date} AND a.shift = #{shift} WHERE e.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY e.section, e.name
